types.description: Harmony XB4 green integral LED light body with metal fixing collar, 24 V AC/DC

document.title: Schneider Electric ZB4BVB3 product datasheet
document.pages: 1–2; exact-product alternate terminal views on pages 8–9 of the 12 September 2026 PDF are cited below

modelingNotes: The historical manufacturer catalogue lists the hyphenated reference explicitly with matching assembly, color, voltage and mass; preserve the source order spelling. Do not substitute the later universal white ZB4BVB1 replacement.

Included assembly is the Zamak fixing collar plus the green protected integral LED block with two screw clamps. The October 2021 catalogue physical 68 / printed 66 explicitly gives XB4BVB3 = ZB4BVB3 + ZB4BV033; the external head/lens is separate. Contact blocks, optional test equipment and grounding plate are not asserted included.

Exact 6 April 2020 datasheet identifies (X1-X2)PL. Exact-product manufacturer PDF https://www.se.com/au/en/product/download-pdf/ZB4BVB3 generated 12 September 2026 shows X1–lamp–X2 on the block side on page 8 and exactly two labeled X1/X2 screws on page 9. Its generic ZBV-XX and xx V/mA placeholders establish topology only when cross-checked with historical exact-order evidence; they do not establish the installed revision or replace historical ratings.

Rated supply is 24 V AC/DC; AC frequency is 50/60 Hz. Operating limits are 19.2–30 V DC and 21.6–26.4 V AC. Scalar nominal_voltage is 24; voltage_type and frequency are omitted because the schema permits only one AC/DC type and one frequency, while the product supports both.

X1 and X2 retain manufacturer terminal names, without invented +/−, L/N or PE aliases. Exact-order sources do not establish a mandatory DC polarity assignment or reverse-polarity tolerance. AC/DC rating alone is not a claim that either DC orientation is acceptable; project wiring must establish its applicable DC arrangement.

One load function with the existing lamp symbol represents the LED input. X1 and X2 remain electrically distinct; no intrinsic fixed links are modeled. Historical catalogue suffix 156 identifies the different three-terminal lamp-test version. No test T screw, test diode, NO/NC contact or communication port belongs to this order.
X1 and X2 are required under library policy for the modeled operating lamp. Required connections do not establish actual voltage, installed identity or engineering suitability.

Class I shock protection and metal collar presence do not prove an upstream protective bond. The collar fixing screw is mechanical, not an invented PE screw. No lamp terminal is bonded to the collar in this model. Protective bonding must be established by the project; coverage remains partial for the collar/support/earthing interface.

Separate ZBZ110 grounding plate is documented by NHA93116 01, 06-2021: https://download.se.com/files?p_Doc_Ref=NHA93116&p_File_Name=NHA93116_01.pdf&p_enDocType=Instruction+sheet. For a non-conducting or painted support, its ground terminal is connected to the grounding circuit. Its inclusion or installation is not presumed.

Historical conditional data: 18 mA lamp consumption, 100,000 h life at rated voltage and 25 °C, 600 V insulation at pollution degree 3, 6 kV impulse withstand, −40…70 °C ambient, screw torque 0.8–1.2 N·m, conductor limits per the sheet. These are documentary conditions, not contact switching ratings or alternate supply voltages.

connectionCoverage.notes: Both lamp field screws X1/X2 are represented, one load function and no fixed links. Included metal collar is described, but installation-dependent collar/support/earthing continuity is not modeled or proven. No PE field screw, head, contact block, grounding plate or test accessory is invented. DC polarity requirements and installed revision remain unverified.

X1.description: Lamp supply screw X1; 24 V AC/DC across X1-X2, 50/60 Hz for AC. Manufacturer key retained; no DC polarity assignment or tolerance claimed.

X2.description: Lamp supply screw X2; 24 V AC/DC across X1-X2, 50/60 Hz for AC. Manufacturer key retained; no DC polarity assignment or tolerance claimed.
